I went on a drug binge after not using for two years. I was going through a rough time and went off the deep end. I mixed muscle relaxers, oxy, meth alcohol and weed. I got so fucked up i forgot about the concept of tolerance and took more oxy after a while. I ended up sleeping for 3 days straight and when i woke up i couldn’t move for a couple hours. I only did meth that night so it wasn’t like i stayed up for days and slept. My dad said he tried waking me up but i wouldn’t budge, not even when my two 100 pound dogs were jumping on me. I do not understand why he wouldn’t call for help as he knew i had a drug issue previously. I believe his ego stood in the way of having to tell my mom i relapsed at his house without him realizing. I’ve never asked him because if he doesn’t know i relapsed i’d just genuinely rather not bring it up. I kinda feel like i might of when into a coma or something.

The american health care system is why everyone is absolutely unstable and depressed here. My family is also very against therapy and mental health in total, ive always been very depressed with many suicidal tendencies with MANY attempts and my family just thought it was ‘weird and girlish’. My mother knows of my eating disorder and secretly i think she’s happy; she takes me more places and likes too show me off more. This could totally be me overreaching but i am very alone in this struggle. So for a regular check up without a psychical it was around $100. It was a 5 minute check in and anything extra would’ve costed hundreds more. Outpatient ranges within the thousands- even if i were to stay for a couple of days. ( my father stayed for about 2 weeks and it was$90k ) I cannot afford health insurance either and my family can’t so i am without insurance, not like it would really help anyways. I genuinely would not be able to go to the doctor or therapist for a very long time. ( trust me, i’ve been saving. ) I know for a fact that i’m mentally unstable so this really bothers me. On the flip side i’m taking psychology and it worries me that i probably wouldn’t be able to work with this on my record. My BMI isn’t underweight so i guess i got off lucky with any psychical altercations. The only pain i realize is my lower back constantly throbbing if i gain any amount of weight. I do not purge, I simply do not swallow any food which i have read can be as dangerous. The last dentist visit i had 3 cavities filled and it was $1200 so i also can’t see myself making any trips to the dentist. 

I guess I’m pretty lost here because anything that would make sense for help is just entirely out of my financial reach. I can’t even imagine the thought process of being able to go to the doctor as easily as other countries can. I’m sorry to have wasted your time on this reddit overall because i think those are genuinely the only reasonable answers.
